key_takeaways: No critical zero-day threats or active malware observed.
One high-priority service configuration issue detected: unencrypted plaintext telemetry port exposed.
Temporary cache storage contains 4.2 GB of reclaimable browser and package manager cache.

findings.title: Plaintext Listening Service Exposed on All Interfaces
findings.description: Port 8080 is listening on 0.0.0.0 without TLS encryption.
findings.remediation: Bind the service to 127.0.0.1 or configure TLS termination.

findings.title: Reclaimable Web Browser Cache
findings.description: Browser cache exceeds configured size threshold of 2.0 GB.
findings.remediation: Execute 'systemscan cleanup' to safely purge cache files.
